name: Board
why: A feature, from a card on the project board to Done with its merged pull request
ideal: One fresh session takes one visual card to one merged pull request; open pull requests carry the limit, and nothing sits in progress unbuilt.

sources.title: GitHub Docs: Best practices for Projects
Claude Code Docs: Manage costs effectively
Anthropic: How we built our multi-agent research system

steps.name: Card
tools: A draft card on the project board
steps.rule: A feature is one card: a picture of its metric and steps, a table, and a pass-or-fail check.

steps.name: Split
tools: Pull requests of 400 lines or fewer
steps.rule: Cut the work so each card lands on its own and shares no file with another card in progress.

steps.name: Start
tools: One app session per card, in its own worktree
Workflow: Pull request linked to issue
steps.rule: A fresh session takes one card; the card is in progress only while its pull request is open.

steps.name: Finish
tools: The app's PR monitor with Auto-fix
steps.rule: Finish before starting: merge a green pull request before opening another.

steps.name: Done
tools: Workflows: Pull request merged, Item closed
steps.rule: The merge moves the card to Done with its pull request linked, within the CI minutes goal; the session ends.

steps.name: Watch
steps.rule: No card sits in progress past a week; a waiting card returns to Todo and names what it waits on.
